title: EventEnvelope
description: GROWTH OS canonical event envelope (BUILD-SPEC §6.1). EVERY business fact on the bus is an envelope. Services own write models; cross-service communication is ONLY via these events (P2). Frozen-after-merge: a new envelope field => version bump. Topic naming = plane.entity.verb (§6.2). The concrete event payload is carried in `payload` and is validated by the matching `<type>.schema.json` keyed off `type`.

event_id.description: Globally unique id for THIS envelope. UUIDv7 (time-ordered): the v7 timestamp gives natural ordering on the bus and in ClickHouse events_raw without a separate sort key (§6.1).

type.description: Canonical event type, dotted (e.g. campaign.requested, lead.scored). Determines which payload schema validates `payload`. Member of the §6.2 catalog (extend-never-mutate).

version.description: Semantic version of the PAYLOAD schema for this `type`. Additive-only within a major; a breaking change bumps major and is a NEW type-version on the bus (P1, §6.2 'version on change').

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the business fact occurred (NOT when it was published). Source of truth for latency SLAs (§11.3 source->dispatched <=15min p95).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant (org). MANDATORY on every event (P6 absolute isolation). Derived from the auth context / connection token, NEVER from caller-supplied body downstream (§3.1 rule). Cache keys, queue messages and ClickHouse sort keys all include it.

workspace_id.description: Owning workspace (vendor/brand) inside the tenant org (§5.1 org->workspace->members). MANDATORY (P6).

correlation_id.description: Journey id (§6.3). Minted ONCE at first touch (ad click / form / inbound msg / lead.captured) and propagated through EVERY event of that person's journey. Identity Graph (§8.3) re-keys this on merge. This single rule makes deterministic ROI reporting possible.

causation_id.description: The `event_id` of the event (or external source id) that directly caused this one — the edge of the causal DAG. Null/absent only for true journey roots (a first-touch campaign.requested or lead.captured).

actor.description: Who/what produced this event (provenance for the Action Ledger + audit, P5).

kind.description: agent = an LLM/typed agent activity; user = a human; system = an internal scheduler/service; webhook = an inbound external source (incl the Origin Connector, §3).

id.description: Stable identifier of the actor within its kind (user uuid, agent/service name, webhook provider id e.g. 'origin', 'meta').

idempotency_key.description: Exactly-once key (P3). For externally-sourced events this is the source system's own event id (e.g. Famit source id via the Origin Connector Idempotency-Key, §3.1). Consumers + the bus dedup on (tenant_id, type, idempotency_key). Replay-safe.

payload.description: The type-specific business payload. Validated by the `<type>.schema.json` in this directory keyed off `type`. Kept as an open object here so the envelope schema is decoupled from payload evolution (payload schemas version independently).

trace.description: Optional OpenTelemetry propagation (P10 observability across HTTP+bus). W3C traceparent/tracestate so a single trace spans publish->consume.

$comment: FROZEN-AFTER-MERGE (D7). Additive-only. To carry a payload, validate `payload` against the schema whose $id matches `type` at version `version`. The registry/index.json maps type@version -> schema $id.
